suggestions: Document the measurement-draw outcome order (S1, contract): QuantumState::measurement_branches (src/quantum.rs) groups outcomes in a BTreeMap<Vec<bool>,...>, so --draws walk outcomes lexicographically over the printed bits string (wire 0 first character = most significant for ordering), NOT in ascending numeric value (value folds bits little-endian in src/classical.rs measure arm). Witness I ran: action h t[0]; h t[1] on qreg:00 gives draw 0.1->bits 00 value 0, 0.3->01 value 2, 0.6->10 value 1, 0.9->11 value 3. Born distribution is correct under either fixed order and §14.2 does not fix a draw mapping, so keep the code and fix the record: state the order in README.md's Measurements paragraph ('draws select the first outcome, in lexicographic order of the bits string (wire 0 first), whose cumulative Born weight exceeds draw x total weight'), add a SPEC-QUESTIONS entry, and pin it in tests/registers.rs with the |++> object above asserting draws 0.3/0.6 give values 2/1.
